scope: Universe rendering, picking, texture uploads and artwork scheduling
Song selection, hover playback, source ownership and audio pooling
Detail panel, background compositing, waveform and scrubber animation
Chart/search APIs, provider caching, concurrency and request budgets
Homepage video lifecycle and media resource ownership (source inspection)
Production build, TypeScript, lint, automated regressions and dependency audit
fixes: Artwork entry, mount and background callers now share a queue; overlapping callers no longer multiply the 16-worker pool.
Late critical artwork no longer reopens loading state after the reveal deadline.
A selected song immediately promotes its pending hover playback and can resume an already selected paused source.
A stable cinematic background prevents accumulating full-screen exit layers during rapid switching; background artwork reuses 256px atlas-sized URLs.
Artwork fade avoids animated blur; waveform and progress fill animate transforms rather than layout.
Covered or hidden universe detaches pointer handlers and clears stale hover state; covered draw calls verified zero.
Regional cold loads use three primary provider queries and at most three fallback queries instead of unbounded full query lists; per-track diagnostics are opt-in via KADENCE_MUSIC_DEBUG=1.
Compatible development dependency updates remove seven moderate npm audit findings.

limitations: Browser latency is a click-to-two-requestAnimationFrame proxy, not an INP metric or audio-start measurement. Baseline used the pre-existing localhost:3000 server; production runs used localhost:3100. Build mode, caches and network can affect comparisons.
390x844 with 4x CPU slowdown is a desktop-browser viewport simulation, not a physical phone or mobile GPU test. Autoplay restriction testing was bypassed in the automated browser.

Regional source data files remain empty. Charts still require the external provider on cold load. Smaller batches returned 90 Telugu / 152 Tamil tracks, versus 256 previously. Third-party availability and all external media URLs were not exhaustively verified.
Existing lint warnings remain (primarily raw image guidance and unused legacy code). Existing user changes and media deletions were preserved.
No production deployment was performed. Production preview left running at http://localhost:3100.
